mapper.sql: C.CMPL_NUMB , C.USER_NUMB , R.USER_NICK AS REPORTER_NICK , C.TAGT_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplTagt}, C.TAGT_TYPE, #{cmplTagt}) AS TAGT_TYPE_NAME , C.TAGT_NUMB , C.TAGT_USER , C.TAGT_CNTN , T.USER_NICK AS TARGET_USER_NICK , C.CMPL_RSON , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplRsonGroup}, C.CMPL_RSON, #{cmplRsonGroup}) AS CMPL_RSON_NAME , C.CMPL_CNTN , C.CMPL_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplStatGroup}, C.CMPL_STAT, #{cmplStatGroup}) AS CMPL_STAT_NAME , C.PROC_CNTN , C.PROC_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(C.PROC_ADMN) AS PROC_ADMN_NAME , C.PROC_DATE , C.REGI_DATE , C.UPDT_DATE

P.CMPL_NUMB , P.USER_NUMB , P.REPORTER_NICK , P.TAGT_TYPE , P.TAGT_TYPE_NAME , P.TAGT_NUMB , P.TAGT_USER , P.TAGT_CNTN , P.TARGET_USER_NICK , P.CMPL_RSON , P.CMPL_RSON_NAME , P.CMPL_CNTN , P.CMPL_STAT , P.CMPL_STAT_NAME , P.PROC_CNTN , P.PROC_ADMN , P.PROC_ADMN_NAME , P.PROC_DATE , P.REGI_DATE , P.UPDT_DATE
mapper.select: SELECT /* getComplaintListCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TH_CMPLNT C LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM R ON R.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT /* getComplaintDtl */
, RPF.FILE_PATH AS REPORTER_PROF_PATH , RBF.FILE_PATH AS REPORTER_BGIM_PATH FROM TH_CMPLNT C LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM R ON R.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM RPF ON RPF.FILE_NUMB = R.PROF_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM RBF ON RBF.FILE_NUMB = R.BGIM_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM T ON T.USER_NUMB = C.TAGT_USER WHERE C.CMPL_NUMB = #{cmplNumb}

SELECT /* getComplaintForUpdate */ C.CMPL_NUMB , C.USER_NUMB , C.TAGT_TYPE , C.TAGT_NUMB , C.TAGT_USER , C.TAGT_CNTN , C.CMPL_RSON , C.CMPL_CNTN , C.CMPL_STAT , C.PROC_CNTN , C.PROC_ADMN , C.PROC_DATE , C.REGI_DATE , C.UPDT_DATE FROM TH_CMPLNT C WHERE C.CMPL_NUMB = #{cmplNumb} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getRelatedComplaintList */
FROM TH_CMPLNT C LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM R ON R.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM T ON T.USER_NUMB = C.TAGT_USER WHERE C.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND C.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND C.CMPL_NUMB != #{cmplNumb} ORDER BY C.REGI_DATE DESC , C.CMPL_NUMB DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT /* getTagtProfFileForUpdate */ F.FILE_NUMB , F.STOR_NAME , F.FILE_PATH FROM TM_USERXM U INNER JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} FOR UPDATE
SELECT /* getTagtBgimFileForUpdate */ F.FILE_NUMB , F.STOR_NAME , F.FILE_PATH FROM TM_USERXM U INNER JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.BGIM_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delTagtFileIfUnref */ F FROM TM_FILEXM F WHERE F.FILE_NUMB = #{fileNumb} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB OR U.BGIM_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* delTargetUserIntroduction */ TM_USERXM SET INTR_CNTN = NULL WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND INTR_CNTN IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delTagtReportChildReply */ C FROM TB_REPLXX C INNER JOIN TM_REPORT P ON P.REPT_NUMB = C.REPT_NUMB AND P.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} WHERE C.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} AND C.UPER_NUMB IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE /* delTargetClubIntroduction */ TM_CLUBXM SET CLUB_CNTN = NULL , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND CLUB_CNTN IS NOT NULL
